commands.name: access can
commands.usage: Ask the cluster's authorizer whether a subject can perform a verb on a resource

commands.name: access list
commands.usage: List the rules a subject holds in a namespace, as the cluster's authorizer reports them

commands.name: access who-can
commands.usage: List the subjects the cluster's authorizer allows to perform a verb on a resource

commands.name: access explain
commands.usage: Explain the cluster's authorizer's decision for a subject, a verb, and a resource

commands.name: access clusters
commands.usage: List the clusters Rancher lets a subject into, and the bindings that grant it

commands.name: access projects
commands.usage: List the projects a subject can see into, and the Rancher memberships behind them

groups.desc: Questions about access, answered by the server: whether a subject can perform a verb on a resource, the rules a subject has in a namespace, which of the subjects named in the cluster's bindings the authorizer allows to perform a verb on a resource, why the authorizer decided as it did for one subject (the chain of Rancher bindings and templates behind the binding it accepted), which clusters Rancher's proxy lets a subject into, with the management bindings that grant that access, and which projects a subject can see into (the authorizer's answer to getting each namespace of the project, summarized per project), kept apart from the ProjectRoleTemplateBindings behind them. The authorizer questions are answered through the Rancher proxy by SubjectAccessReview, SelfSubjectAccessReview or SelfSubjectRulesReview; which clusters a subject can reach is the proxy's own answer; the bindings are only read, and the client never evaluates them.
groups.name: access
